purpose: Describe natural same-task Codex input-token variation under the explicitly selected unelevated research backend; not a policy gate or winner-selection benchmark.

execution.baseline_prompt: Exact original M01 task bytes; no preprocessing and no locator.
execution.middle_man_prompt: Exact original M01 task passed through unchanged production AUTO; only its normal source-free locator may be appended.

snapshot_rule: Prepare four independent, clean, committed, source-identical pinned repositories outside the primary working tree; preserve tracked AGENTS.md at the pinned blob and add no benchmark AGENTS.md; verify all four before call 1 and each again after its arm; never reuse a snapshot.

each_arm: pinned source commit, tree, content fingerprint, selector fingerprint, clean snapshot, and unchanged tracked AGENTS.md
exact original M01 task bytes and task SHA-256
locked CLI, model, effort, timeout, unelevated backend, read-only isolation, and zero MCP registration
zero process exit and parsed nonempty final answer; no malformed JSONL or failed turn
no unexpected external-tool or MCP activity
unchanged repository HEAD, porcelain status, and Git-visible content after execution
semantic PASS under the unchanged original M01 rubric

analysis.within_arm_percent_of_mean: 100 * abs(signed difference) / that arm's two-run input mean
analysis.all_four_input_range: max(B_A, B_B, M_A, M_B) - min(B_A, B_B, M_A, M_B)
analysis.cached_input_variation: Report both within-arm cached-input differences separately.
analysis.input_minus_cached: For each observation report input_tokens - cached_input_tokens; DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - NOT BILLING OR QUOTA.

historical_exclusions.v1_stopped_incomplete: One runtime-successful but semantically failed baseline; calls 2-4 were not started. Exclude from V2 sample.
historical_exclusions.prior_valid_m01: Middle_Man minus baseline input was -8219 tokens (-2.3535%) under a different backend; directional context only, not a V2 replicate.
